question: Should Crabline preserve existing ownership and recorderPath behavior during upgrades, or intentionally adopt fail-closed UID ownership and generation-snapshot recorder paths as new contracts?
rationale: The patch changes operator recovery and published artifact semantics; automated tests cannot determine whether those breaking behaviors are intended permanent contracts.

options.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility
options.body: Add a safe ownership migration or compatibility path and keep recorderPath stable or version the snapshot path separately.

options.title: Approve strict new contracts
options.body: Accept fail-closed ownership and snapshot recorderPath only with explicit migration documentation and real fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Split contract changes
options.body: Separate independently safe durability fixes from the ownership and recorderPath policy changes.

recommendation.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility
recommendation.body: Add a safe ownership migration or compatibility path and keep recorderPath stable or version the snapshot path separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The permanent compatibility policy should be decided by the owner identified through CODEOWNERS or current-main history, which was not available in the supplied metadata.
